sloka: लाङ्गूलं संप्रदीप्तं तु द्रष्टुं तस्य हनूमतः ।सहस्त्रीबालवृद्धाश्च जग्मुः प्रीता निशाचराः ।। 5.53.9।।।।
transliteration: lāṅgūlaṁ saṁpradīptaṁ tu draṣṭuṁ tasya hanūmataḥ ।sahastrībālavṛddhāśca jagmuḥ prītā niśācarāḥ ।। 5.53.9।।।।

translations.english: All the demons including the shedemons and their children and the elders went out joyfully to see the burning tail of Hanuman.
